name: privacyprint
description: PrivacyPrint — privacy-first, multi-tenant print-job platform (monorepo root).

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix apps/api install && npm --prefix apps/web install
scripts.dev: npm --prefix apps/api run start & npm --prefix apps/web run dev & wait
scripts.test: npm --prefix apps/api test && npm --prefix services/print-connector test
